capabilities: blur values wrapped in {{double curly braces}} until hovered
copy a secret to the clipboard via a button without displaying it
render secrets across reading view, Live Preview, source mode and tables
leave code blocks, inline code and core Templates placeholders untouched
disambiguation: Not an encryption or password-manager tool; it only hides values visually while they stay as plain text in the .md file.
extras: The README carries a prominent security warning: secrets are not encrypted and remain readable in the .md file by sync services, backups, other plugins and Obsidian search; it recommends a password manager or encrypted vault for real protection at rest. The plugin only writes to the clipboard, never reads it.
problem: Passwords, API keys and tokens stored in notes are fully visible on screen, which is a problem when sharing your screen, presenting, or working where others can see your monitor.
summary: Redaction plugin that blurs {{secret}} values in notes and adds a one-click copy button so credentials never show on screen.
